title: HatReD: Multi-Domain Hateful Meme Detection
description: Hateful meme detection requiring understanding of both image and text. Annotators classify memes as hateful or not, identify the target of hate, and explain why the meme is hateful. Based on the HatReD dataset spanning multiple domains of online meme content.
